newsitem.title: USA: Solucorp Industries eyes SmallCap listing.
newsitem.headline: Solucorp Industries eyes SmallCap listing.

text.p: Solucorp Industries Ltd said it has begun efforts to list its stock on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
Solucorp, which develops ways to solve environmental problems related to heavy metals contamination, said it has hired the law firm of Sommer & Schneider for the purpose.
It said it also expects to file its 10K-SB financial report to regulators as a first step in securing a Nasdaq listing.
Solucorp, a Canadian company doing business in the United States, is currently quoted in the over-the-counter bulletin board under the symbol, a company spokesman said.
